Rabia once spearheaded a project to refine our fraud detection model. She designed an A/B test comparing two algorithms, which resulted in a 15% improvement in false positive rates. Her visualizations—using Plotly to track real-time performance—made complex trade-offs clear during stakeholder meetings. When the team debated whether to prioritize speed or accuracy, her charts clarified the business impact of each choice.  

We’ve collaborated daily for over a year, reviewing code during standups and troubleshooting pipeline issues. Rabia’s knack for distilling technical problems into actionable insights made her a go-to resource. She’s also mastered SQL analytics, pulling together disparate datasets to uncover patterns others missed.  

Rabia’s strength lies in her analytical rigor and communication clarity. She once engineered a feature set that boosted our predictive model’s accuracy by 10%, then documented the process in a Jupyter notebook that new hires used as a training tool. Her statistical modeling skills shone during a recent project, where she quantified the cost of delays in loan approvals, guiding the team to optimize workflows.  

In short, Rabia is a dependable collaborator who consistently delivers value through precision and curiosity. Her work ethic is unshakable—she’ll stay late to debug a query or refactor legacy code without prompting.  

Rabia Yilmaz, Data Scientist. Contact: r.yilmaz@fintechinnovators.com.
